data.desc: Flyte Aviation, Inc. (NYSE American: VJET) is an AI technology-driven private aviation company focused on making private air travel simpler, more transparent and increasingly accessible. Flyte's simple value proposition: privacy, comfort, reliability, and convenience - at a highly competitive price. Through its Flyte platform, the Company is building a technology-enabled private aviation ecosystem connecting customers with aircraft, destinations and experiences through an increasingly seamless digital experience.
